name: Live notifications
description: A rotating Home Assistant live-status bar for your dashboard, screensaver, or both. Native KS styling, manual placement, and a sample preview.
author: dimatx

settings.title: Show live notifications
settings.description: Enable live notifications in the display scope below. Turning this off hides all live notifications; sample preview is separate.

settings.title: Show on
settings.description: Always shows on the dashboard and screensaver. Dashboard only excludes the screensaver and stays below KS menus and other native screens. Does not change screensaver settings.

settings.title: Style
settings.description: Native follows Kiosk Satellite's theme, like Navbar and Action Bar. Glass uses the translucent dark chip with light text. Placement and size stay the same.

settings.title: Text and icon size
settings.description: At a Glance title/status proportions. To match it manually, use the same percentage as its Row scaling. This does not read or change stock settings.

settings.title: Notifications
settings.description: Shown in this order when their visibility rules match. Use up to 16 different Home Assistant entities across enabled notifications; reused entities count once.

fields.title: Primary entity
fields.description: Provides the notification's name, icon and status text. Its state also decides when to show it, unless you choose different sources below.

fields.title: Notification label
fields.description: Leave empty to use the entity's friendly name.

fields.title: Use different sources
fields.description: Choose separate sources for status text, icon or visibility. Leave any source blank to use the primary entity. Turn off to use the primary entity for all three.

fields.title: Status text source
fields.description: Changes the text shown in the chip, not when it appears. Leave blank to use the primary entity.

fields.title: Status text attribute
fields.description: Leave blank to show the status text source's state. To show one of that entity's attributes instead, enter its name, such as remaining if your entity provides it.

fields.title: Icon source
fields.description: Changes only the icon. Leave blank to use the primary entity's icon.

fields.title: Visibility source
fields.description: The entity checked by Show when below. Does not change the status text. Leave blank to check the primary entity.

fields.title: Visibility attribute
fields.description: Leave blank to check the visibility source's state. To check one of that entity's attributes instead, enter its name, such as ready if your entity provides it.

fields.title: Show when
fields.description: Checks the visibility source, or the primary entity by default. Available means the needed data can be read; unknown or unavailable data never matches.

fields.title: Compare with
fields.description: Enter the state exactly as Home Assistant reports it, such as on, or a number such as 25.5. Letter case matters.

fields.title: Progress bar
fields.description: Automatic detects a displayed percentage. Off keeps the bar hidden. On lets you choose a custom progress source, read as 0-100 percent.

fields.title: Progress source
fields.description: Leave blank to use the status text source. Choose a different entity to show completion separately from text such as time remaining. Progress must be from 0 to 100.

fields.title: Progress attribute
fields.description: To use an attribute of the progress source, enter its name, such as completion if available. Leave blank to use its state. If both progress fields are blank, the bar uses the same value as the status text.

fields.title: Show percentage text
fields.description: Turn off to let a valid bar replace matching percentage digits. Other status text stays; percentage text is retained if no valid bar is shown.

fields.title: Live indicator
fields.description: A small, softly pulsing light while this notification's sources are available. Motion set to None keeps the light still. The entity icon stays still.

settings.title: Style on screensaver
settings.description: Default follows Style in User interface. Native uses the KS theme; Glass uses the translucent dark chip. This changes only the notification, not your screensaver or clock.

settings.title: Motion
settings.description: Roller animates transitions with a clipped 580 ms cylinder roll and lets enabled live indicators pulse. None disables both animations; the light stays static. Android's disabled animations are respected too.

settings.title: Anchor
settings.description: Manual placement only. The plugin cannot detect or automatically avoid clocks or widgets.

settings.title: Horizontal offset
settings.description: Enter a whole number in dp. Positive moves right; negative moves left. KS keeps the chip on screen.

settings.title: Vertical offset
settings.description: Enter a whole number in dp. Positive moves down; negative moves up.

settings.title: Width
settings.description: Adaptive uses 480 dp in landscape and 320 dp in portrait, capped by available space. Custom keeps your chosen width.

settings.title: Custom chip width
settings.description: Fixed width across notifications, capped by available screen space. Follows KS Scale UI.

settings.title: Preview sample notifications
settings.description: Cycles labeled sample data, even with no configured entities. Stops when turned off, the settings page closes, the screen turns off, or after two minutes. Does not start or replace a screensaver.
